brief.zh: 已知「下雨」为真，证出「下雨」为真。
brief.en: Given that “it rains” is true, prove that “it rains” is true.

hint.zh: 从「已知」元件右边的圆点，连到「目标」元件左边的圆点。
hint.en: Wire the dot on the right of the “Given” part to the dot on the left of the “Goal” part.

t.zh: 这台证明器的地基只有两块元件，后面的一切都要在它们上面搭出来。先看板子：左边的元件是已知，右边是目标，一根线的意思是「这句话已经证明为真」。
t.en: This prover’s foundation is two parts, and everything else is built on them. First the board: the parts on the left are given, the one on the right is the goal, and a wire means “this sentence has been proved true”.

t.zh: 板子下面是几组测试，每组讲一件不同的事；同一块电路要在每一组上都证得出。
t.en: Under the board are a few tests, each about something different; one circuit must prove every one of them.

after.zh: 已知为真的话，本身就是一个证明。
after.en: A given is already a proof of itself.
